apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.description: Visual Studio Code is a lightweight but powerful source code editor which runs on your desktop and is available for Windows, macOS and Linux. It comes with built-in support for JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js and has a rich ecosystem of extensions for other languages and runtimes.

apps.name: Obsidian
apps.description: Obsidian is a powerful knowledge base that works on top of a local folder of plain text Markdown files. It features bidirectional linking, graph view, and a plugin ecosystem.

apps.name: Slack
apps.description: Slack is a messaging app for business that connects people to the information they need. By bringing people together to work as one unified team, Slack transforms the way organizations communicate.

apps.name: GIMP
apps.description: GIMP is a cross-platform image editor available for GNU/Linux, macOS, Windows and more operating systems. It is free software, you can change its source code and distribute your changes.

apps.name: Inkscape
apps.description: Inkscape is a Free and open source vector graphics editor for GNU/Linux, Windows and macOS. It offers a rich set of features and is widely used for both artistic and technical illustrations.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.description: Firefox is a free and open-source web browser developed by the Mozilla Foundation. It uses the Gecko rendering engine to display web pages, which implements current and anticipated web standards.

apps.name: Chromium
apps.description: Chromium is an open-source browser project that aims to build a safer, faster, and more stable way for all users to experience the web.

apps.name: LibreOffice
apps.description: LibreOffice is a free and powerful office suite, and a successor to OpenOffice.org. Its clean interface and feature-rich tools help you unleash your creativity and enhance your productivity.

apps.name: VLC
apps.description: VLC is a free and open source cross-platform multimedia player and framework that plays most multimedia files as well as DVDs, Audio CDs, VCDs, and various streaming protocols.

apps.name: Discord
apps.description: Discord is your place to talk and hang out. Where you can belong to a school club, a gaming group, or a worldwide art community. Where just you and a few friends can spend time together.

apps.name: Open WebUI
apps.description: Open WebUI is a user-friendly interface for interacting with large language models. It supports Ollama, OpenAI, and other backends.

apps.name: Auto-Claude
apps.description: Auto-Claude is an autonomous multi-agent coding framework that plans, builds, and validates software for you. It features a Kanban-style interface for managing AI coding tasks across multiple sessions.
